label: Scratch Pad
title: Scratch Pad
subtitle: A shared free-text notepad that all agents in a project can read and write. Agents use it to leave notes, record intermediate findings, and pass context to each other in plain language.
whenToUse: Use when agents need to share working notes across turns. Simpler than the Data Layer for text-based information that does not need to be structured or queried.

methods.name: Append to Scratch Pad
methods.description: Adds text to the end of the current scratchpad content.

methods.name: Update Scratch Pad
methods.description: Replaces the entire scratchpad content with new text.

mediaCaption: The Scratchpad section of the Project Overview showing the shared notes the agents have written during the session
tips: Scratchpad content is automatically included in every agent's context window — they see it without needing to call a Read method.
